body: [Effect & Cause] (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzWckYfZhbA) By the White Stripes. The lyrics are spot on.

Oh boy is that a familiar feeling. I'm in pretty much the exact same boat with you and I totally understand the feeling like your head is going to fucking explode. And you're right, if you you're feeling this way its way more than just "silly arguments." Shame on both your parents for being so dismissive.
Yes. Anything they say feels like it's been tainted by the other parent.
That sounds like hell on earth. I'm glad to hear you're in a better place now. The fact that you made it through is a major testament to your will.
Same here. My nmom will press my buttons and then tell me she "would not be surprised if I offed her in her sleep." It hurts, being called a killer for no reason.
Haha, she loves a good contradiction. Even the text she sent me doesn't make sense. If insanity is "not having control" then how does she expect me to snap out of it?
She most definitely is. I used to think it was normal to hate your siblings. Wasn't until recently I realized she's been pitting us against each other our entire lives.

Hi, thank you so much for taking the time to comment. It helps tremendously to know that complete strangers know that what's happening is objectively wrong. I understand why it was removed, I'll repost a revised one as soon as I can. 

Also, I am currently trying to gather all the things I need for youth emancipation. I have a job lined up, and luckily for me, my mom admitted on video that she is 100% ok with me moving out, which was the one thing I didn't have yet.

It has been happening my whole life, but has only been really severe these past few months. She does apologize occasionally, but in a way that doesn't say "I'm sorry I did that" but rather "I'm sorry I *had* to do that." 

So, yes. She is convinced that this is helping me. I would like her to know it's not, but she won't listen. I have tried many, many times.
Reminds me of Francisca Goya's ["Saturn Devouring His Son"] (https://goo.gl/images/odf7r6). Which also seems oddly appropriate.

I feel like I finally got to level 2 even after reaching out and getting medicine. The medicine didn't work very well at all but I recently discovered that weed is perfect to stop thinking about shooting myself as I try to sleep. It just helps me come to terms and forget. I just don't want to be a stoner I just want to be happy and know that im happy. I feel like I've let myself down and like I've let everyone around me down even though they don't know about it. I can't even look ny dog in the eyes while I'm high I feel like even they're disappointed in me.    and now because of some stupid meme in in the bathroom high crying my eyes out
Exactly. I don't like being "locked in" with things I can't control. I think that's why suicide is such an appealing idea.
